displayName: Local LLM Knowledge Base（本地大模型知识库·免 API Key）
description: Run a private LLM knowledge base on hardware you already own: no API key, no GPU purchase, and no documents leaving your machine. Point it at your own PDFs and notes, then ask questions in plain language and get answers grounded in those files. Use when data cannot leave the building, the budget for model APIs is zero, or an old desktop is all you have. 零成本 · 免 API Key · 数据不出门——你的旧电脑就能跑大模型、建知识库，不用买显卡（在线版 https://medxpert.cn）

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
